summary: Big Digital Energy, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 27, 2026, disclosing a definitive Joint Mining Agreement with affiliate BDE, owned by its Executive Chair, CEO, and COO. BDE acquires ~25,000 mining computers; the Company provides ~75MW capacity. Ownership transfers to Big Digital after BDE recoups its ROI. The parties share profits 50/50: Big Digital receives all cash net proceeds; BDE gets monthly grants of stock (20% of share, at 30-day VWAP, currently ~$4.94) and warrants (80% of share, exercise price $20). This is an internal arrangement, not a conventional M&A or activist event.
